items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Johnson was the king. He came there with King Oliver... Jimmy Noon is from New Orleans, King Oliver is from New Orleans

ctx.x: Yeah, they made cigars, rolled cigars. They all got… most of the violin players were from Louisiana and they knew how to roll… make cigars so on that back porch [unintelligible] three stories out and a back porch. They would sit there in the morning and roll these fine cigars and take them down and sell them to the department stores. So this is the way they survived. And I really didn‟t know this until [laugh] I went by one day and saw the guys that I knew doing this thing. This is what they did… how they…
